In the Czech First League, Mladá Boleslav were runners up in [[2005–06 Czech First League|2005–06]] and on third place in [[2006–07 Czech First League|2006–07]] and [[2013–14 Czech First League|2013–14]]. The club won the [[Czech Cup]] in [[2010–11 Czech Cup|2010–11]] and [[2015–16 Czech Cup|2015–16]]. In 2024–25, the club participated in the European Cups for the tenth time and qualified for the group stage for the third time."}}
